breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained a contradiction by asking to use the exact torsion relation (via the polar moment of inertia J) and also a thin-walled tube approximation. The ground truth resolves this by removing the instruction for the thin-walled approximation. The agent's generated specification failed to fix this and kept both contradictory instructions, stating to 'Model the hollow shaft as a thin-walled closed tube' while also instructing to 'Use the polar moment of inertia J = π(do^4 − di^4)/32'.
